# NULL JSFX

> 73 professional audio effects for Cockos Reaper. Minimal design, maximum precision. Free and open source.

## Overview
NULL JSFX is a suite of 73 audio effect plugins written in EEL2 for Cockos Reaper's JSFX platform. Organized into three categories: ONE SLIDER (single-control effects), ESSENTIALS (daily-use tools), and ADVANCED (specialized processing). The One Slider plugins also ship as GFX JSFX (own interface, REAPER) and as VST3/CLAP plugins for any DAW on Windows, macOS and Linux; every version sounds identical to the original JSFX.

### One Slider (20)
One control, instant result. Turn it up until it sounds right.

- Brighter: One-Knob Treble Lift
- Chorus One: One-Knob Stereo Chorus
- Crunch: One-Knob Hard Distortion
- Doubler: Automatic Double Tracking
- Driver: One-Knob Warm Tube Drive
- Exciter: Harmonic High Enhancer
- Formant Shift: Vocal Formant Morph
- Grit: One-Knob Bitcrusher
- Louder: One-Knob Loudness Maximizer
- Mono Maker: Low-End Mono Summing
- Phatter: One-Knob Low-End Boost
- Pressure: One-Knob Bus Compressor
- Pumper: Tempo-Synced Volume Pump
- Riser: One-Knob Build-Up
- Snappy: One-Knob Transient Shaper
- Spread: Mono-Safe Stereo Widener
- Stretch: Granular Pitch Stretch
- Sweeper: DJ Filter Sweep
- Tilt: One-Knob Tilt EQ (also as GFX, VST3, CLAP)
- Wetter: One-Knob Room Reverb

### Essentials (31)
The everyday mixing and mastering toolbox.

- Auto Pan: LFO Stereo Panner
- Auto-Leveler: Automatic Gain Rider
- Breath Control: Vocal Breath Reduction
- Cabinet Simulator: Speaker Cabinet Simulation
- Channel Utility: Gain, Phase & Routing
- Chorus: Classic Delay Chorus
- Click Repair: Click & Pop Removal
- DeEsser: Split-Band Sibilance Control
- Delay: Stereo Echo & Slapback
- Dynamic EQ: Four-Band Dynamic EQ
- Dynamics: Compressor & Expander
- Envelope Follower: Auto-Wah & Envelope Filter
- Filter: Resonant Multi-Mode Filter
- Flanger: Jet Sweep Flanger
- Gate: Noise Gate with Sidechain HPF
- Limiter: Limiter, Clipper & Brickwall
- Maximizer: Look-Ahead Loudness Maximizer
- Mid/Side Matrix: M/S Encode & Decode
- Multiband Comp: Four-Band Compressor
- Noise Generator: White, Pink & Brown Noise
- Parametric EQ: Five-Band Parametric EQ
- Phaser: All-Pass Sweep Phaser
- Pitch Shifter: Real-Time Pitch Shift
- Reverb: Compact Stereo Algorithmic Reverb
- Ring Mod: Swept Ring Modulator
- Saturation: Six-Mode Saturation
- Sidechain Ducker: Sidechain Ducking
- Stereo Width: M/S Width with Mono Bass
- Transient Shaper: Attack & Sustain Shaper
